arguments.value: UTEK Corporation and World Energy Solutions entered into a 12-month strategic alliance agreement under which UTEK would act as an independent contractor to help identify, review, and, if requested and mutually agreed, negotiate technology acquisition opportunities for World Energy Solutions, mainly from universities and government laboratories. In return, World Energy Solutions would pay UTEK with unregistered common stock worth $120,000, with shares vesting monthly and unvested shares returned if the agreement ended early. Each party would pay its own expenses. The agreement requires both parties to keep confidential information secret, comply with securities and disclosure rules, approve joint public statements in writing, and refrain from soliciting each other’s employees for 24 months. Either party could terminate on 30 days’ written notice, and the agreement also includes indemnity, assignment, notice, injunctive relief, and attorneys’ fees provisions. The source does not state a governing law.
